prompt: Complete items 1, 2, and 3 for G1: freeze the native Target contract, implement explicit conversation-first human-confirmed Target creation, and establish minimal native WorkGraph, Stage, Attention, and Run behavior.
allowed_actions: Add native Workspace-scoped Collection, Target, Conversation draft, WorkGraph, GraphRevision, WorkNode, Run, audit, outbox, and receipt contracts
Add forward-only PostgreSQL migrations through the repository migration workflow
Add human-authorized and idempotent Go Domain API commands
Expose native read contracts and product UI without compatibility projection
Add focused TypeScript, Go, integration, UI, locale, and browser tests
Update canonical product, ontology, architecture, ADR, API, and delivery evidence documents
forbidden_actions: Make TypeScript a second writer of native Target, Graph, or Run facts
Treat Conversation, Project, Case, Issue, Artifact, Heartbeat, or Temporal history as native Target truth
Implement unapproved Submission, Evidence, Review, Acceptance, external Effect, or ship commands
Delete compatibility storage or user data
Commit, push, merge, deploy, release, or create a ship record without explicit approval
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run <12 focused G1 files> --reporter=verbose
expected_evidence: Native domain schema and migration safety results
Draft immutability, confirmation ownership, and conversion replay results
Atomic Target and initial graph command results
Graph activation and Run idempotency results
Typecheck, focused tests, Go tests, build, browser, locale, token, migration, and diff results
Truthful repository-wide suite gap and independent review requirements
stop_conditions: The implementation requires compatibility facts to enter the native read model
A second native writer or long-term dual write is required
Workspace or human authority cannot be enforced
Idempotency cannot distinguish replay from conflicting payloads
A migration cannot be forward-only and safety-checked
